task_completion.description: Load the 1EHZ structure and isolate Chain A.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '1EHZ' or a similar name, and the viewer displays a single tRNA molecule rather than the full crystal asymmetric unit.

task_completion.description: Color-code the four main structural domains (Acceptor, D-arm, Anticodon, T-arm) using distinct colors.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The tRNA molecule in the viewer is divided into at least four distinct color segments corresponding to the specified residue ranges.

task_completion.description: Measure the straight-line distance from residue 76 to residue 35.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line (wizard or distance command) is visible in the 3D viewer connecting the terminal end to the anticodon loop, with a numerical label displayed (typically between 65-85 Å).

task_completion.description: Render and save the visualization to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL command history shows a 'png' or 'export' command targeting '~/PyMOL_Data/images/trna_domains.png'.
The agent selects or labels a residue with a non-standard code (e.g., PSU, 5MC, OMG, 7MG, H2U) in the PyMOL GUI or terminal.

task_completion.description: Write a structural analysis report with all required components.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output shows a file named 'trna_structure_report.txt' containing at least 5 lines, listing the 4 domains, the distance, and the modified nucleotide.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL software directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL GUI, command line input, and 3D manipulation of the molecule rather than just static images or pre-written text.

integrity.description: The agent derived the distance from the software measurement tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: The distance value in the report matches the measurement label visible in the PyMOL 3D viewport.

integrity.description: The agent used the correct directory structure.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands or file browser windows show the creation of the 'PyMOL_Data' and 'images' subdirectories.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The PDB ID is 1EHZ. The distance between residue 76 (3' end) and residue 35 (anticodon) should be approximately 67-80 Angstroms. Common modified nucleotides in 1EHZ include PSU (Pseudouridine), 5MC (5-Methylcytidine), OMG (2'-O-Methylguanosine), 7MG (7-Methylguanosine), and H2U (Dihydrouridine). The report must be at least 5 lines long and include the four domain names: Acceptor stem, D-arm, Anticodon arm, and T-arm.
